privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How ReelBot handles your information and the choices you have.
sections: Who we are
ReelBot is a movie discovery service available at reelbot.movie. This policy explains how we handle your information and how to contact us.
Information we collect

Account information: your email address, account identifier, optional display name and sign-in records. Supabase manages authentication. If you choose Google sign-in, we receive your basic profile information, including your name, email address, profile image and Google account identifier. We use it to create and authenticate your ReelBot account, not to access Gmail, Drive or your contacts.

Movie activity: saved, watched and excluded movies, preferences, recommendation requests and follow-up questions. Some guest preferences and recent activity stay in your browser; account movie lists are stored to sync across devices.

Feedback: the message and optional email you submit, the page URL and browser information. Usage and technical information: pages visited, product actions, session identifiers, device/browser information, performance and errors. Hosting and analytics providers may process IP addresses and approximate location.

With analytics consent, we retain a short activity log for guests and signed-in visitors containing redacted movie requests and follow-up questions, returned movies or answers, response times, landing paths, referral domains and campaign tags. We do not send this request text to Google Analytics or Vercel Analytics. Only authorized super administrators can view this log. Obvious email addresses, phone numbers, links and credential-like text are removed automatically; please avoid including personal information.
How we use and share information

We use information to run accounts, personalize movie picks, sync your library, answer feedback, measure performance and protect the service. Authorized administrators can access account and activity information for support and administration.

Supabase provides authentication and storage; Vercel and Render host the service; OpenAI processes recommendation requests and relevant movie preferences; TMDB supplies movie data; Google Analytics and Vercel provide usage and performance analytics. Providers process information under their own applicable terms and policies. Please do not include sensitive personal information in movie requests.

Google account information is used for sign-in and account management. We do not sell it, use it for advertising or send it to OpenAI to train AI models. Other information may be disclosed when legally required, to protect users and the service, or as part of a transfer of the service subject to applicable law.

When you share a pick, its movie, request summary and recommendation explanation may be stored and visible to anyone with the link. Avoid including personal information in a pick you share. External streaming and other linked sites have their own privacy practices.
Cookies and browser storage

We use cookies or similar browser storage for sign-in, preferences, recent picks and usage measurement. Google Analytics uses cookies. Optional Google Analytics, Vercel usage/performance analytics and ReelBot product metrics stay off until you select Accept analytics. Reject analytics keeps them off. You can change or withdraw your choice using Cookie settings in the footer; withdrawal reloads the page to stop loaded analytics scripts. We remember your choice for up to six months. You can block cookies and tracking or clear stored information through your browser settings; this may affect sign-in and saved preferences.
For administrators who open the admin dashboard, a signed browser marker helps exclude their own signed-out test activity. This marker lasts up to 30 days and does not grant account access.
Storage and your choices

Account information and movie lists are retained while your account exists. Feedback, shared picks, usage records and operational logs may remain until deleted; we do not currently apply one automatic deletion period to all records. Providers may retain backups and security records under their policies. Information may be processed in the United States and other countries where our providers operate.

You can update your profile, remove saved movies and delete your account in Account settings. Account deletion removes your account and associated account movie lists; separately submitted feedback, shared links, usage records and provider backups may remain. You can also revoke Google access in your Google Account settings.

To request access, correction or deletion of other personal information, use Feedback in the footer, select Something else, and include an email where we can reply. Depending on your location, you may have additional rights, including objection, restriction, portability or a complaint to your local privacy authority. We may need to verify your identity.

The admin request log reports the last seven days. Its stored event batches are subject to automatic cleanup after eight days; backups and provider security logs may follow different retention periods.
Children, security and changes

ReelBot is not directed to children under 13. If you believe a child has provided personal information, contact us through Feedback so we can investigate and remove it. We use access controls and secure connections, but no online service can guarantee complete security.

We will update this page when our practices change and provide additional notice of material changes where required. The date above identifies the current version. For privacy questions, use Feedback in the footer.

terms.title: Terms of Service
sections: Using ReelBot

ReelBot is a movie discovery service available at reelbot.movie. These terms apply when you use the service. You must be at least 13 and meet any higher minimum age required where you live. If you are below the age of legal adulthood, use ReelBot with a parent or guardian’s permission.
Your account and submissions
Keep your sign-in details secure and provide accurate account information. You are responsible for activity you authorize through your account. You can delete your account in Account settings.

You retain any rights you have in your submissions. You give ReelBot permission to process them as needed to provide the service and handle your feedback. Only submit content you have the right to use. Information handling is described in our Privacy Policy.
Fair use

Do not use ReelBot unlawfully, infringe others’ rights, submit harmful content, bypass security or rate limits, or disrupt the service. Do not use automated requests that overload the site. We may restrict or suspend access to protect users or respond to misuse.
Recommendations and third parties

AI recommendations and movie information can be inaccurate. Check ratings, content suitability, availability and prices with the relevant provider before watching or purchasing. ReelBot does not supply streaming access. Third-party services have their own terms.

ReelBot branding and software belong to their respective owners. Movie information, posters and other third-party materials remain the property of their owners; use of ReelBot does not grant ownership of those materials.
Availability and responsibility

We may update, change or discontinue features. To the extent permitted by law, the service is provided as available without warranties of uninterrupted access or accuracy. To the extent permitted by law, ReelBot is not responsible for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the service. Nothing in these terms excludes liability or consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded.
Changes and contact

We will post updated terms here and provide notice of material changes where required. Updated terms apply prospectively; if you do not agree, stop using the service and close your account. For questions or concerns, use Feedback in the footer and include an email where we can reply.
